_note: v2.8 plan 69 K8 (no-model lane). Host fact: ST's saveChat (script.js) writes the chat file and emits no MESSAGE_* event, so another extension that rewrites chat[n].mes and saves leaves no event behind; our fingerprints (runtime/fingerprints.ts) are compared at the next boundary (chatSave.reconcile). Expected outcome: no rollback until the next boundary; then the fingerprint mismatch steps back from the rewritten reply once and the boundary commits once. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-69-k8-silent-rewrite.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

steps.eval: const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState(); if (s.lastMessageId !== 1 || s.blackboard.values.lit_lamp !== true) throw new Error('setup: ' + JSON.stringify({ last: s.lastMessageId, values: s.blackboard.values })); const markRt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ms = markRt.getEngineState(); globalThis.__k8 = { boundary: ms.boundary, last: ms.lastMessageId, length: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, recommits: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.editReread?.stats().recommits ?? null }; return globalThis.__k8;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const seen = []; const names = ['MESSAGE_EDITED', 'MESSAGE_UPDATED', 'MESSAGE_SWIPED', 'MESSAGE_DELETED']; const handlers = names.map((name) => { const handler = () => seen.push(name); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes[name], handler); return [name, handler]; }); try { ctx.chat[1].mes = 'I blow out the oil lamp by the door.'; if (Array.isArray(ctx.chat[1].swipes)) ctx.chat[1].swipes[ctx.chat[1].swipe_id ?? 0] = ctx.chat[1].mes; await ctx.saveChat(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); } finally { for (const [name, handler] of handlers) ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes[name], handler); } if (seen.length) throw new Error('the silent rewrite emitted ' + seen.join(', ')); return { events: seen };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s = rt.getEngineState(); return { boundary: s.boundary, last: s.lastMessageId, values: s.blackboard.values, length: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, recommits: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.editReread?.stats().recommits ?? null, mark: globalThis.__k8 };

const out = (() => { const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const s = rt.getEngineState(); return { boundary: s.boundary, last: s.lastMessageId, values: s.blackboard.values, length: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, recommits: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.editReread?.stats().recommits ?? null, mark: globalThis.__k8 }; })(); const s = out; if (s.values.lit_lamp === true) throw new Error('lit_lamp, read from the line that was rewritten, survived'); if (s.last !== 2) throw new Error('the boundary after the rewrite did not commit message 2: last=' + s.last); return s;
